items.label: Toy Rocket Launcher for Kids
items.value: Our rocket launcher set includes Launch Hose x1, Launch Stand x1, Launch Base x1, Launch Tube x1, Step Pad x1, User Manual x1, Fabric Volcano Skirt x1, Fixed Ring x2, Launch Stand Legs x3, Rockets(Decorate them with stickers by hand) x8. For children aged 3 years and above

items.label: Launches Up to 100 Ft
items.value: With the help of your steps, the rocket outdoor toy can launch up to 100 feet. Kids will release all that energy by running and jumping for hours! Play in the yard, park, beach, playground or anywhere you want

items.label: Durable and Safe Material
items.value: The toys rocket launcher is made with soft foam and plastic. The soft foam rockets heads are safe for kids, they can enjoy hours of rocket launching fun with it. The foam rocket is safe and durable, making it a great choice for outdoor games

items.label: Easy to Assemble and Storage
items.value: Our rocket toy is easy to assemble, Comes with a detailed instruction manual, even without reading the instructions, it takes only a few minutes to assemble.No need for batteries assemble. The detachable launcher stand can be stored easily in small spaces. A great choice for carry and travel

items.label: Idea Gifts
items.value: Our toy rocket launcher is soft enough to play indoors/outroom. It is the best gift for kids on Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving Day, New Year, etc. Also the best birthday gifts for 3 4 5 6 7 8+ year old boys girls
